name: Littlestone Dimension of Tagged Singletons
proof: Choose a tag coordinate $t$.  On the $t=1$ branch, querying an ordinary coordinate assigned tag $t$ separates its tag singleton from its tagged pair; on the $t=0$ branch, querying a distinct tag coordinate separates $\emptyset$ from that tag singleton.  This shatters a depth-two tree.  At an ordinary coordinate, the positive branch is a singleton class, while at a tag coordinate the positive branch is a star and has Littlestone dimension one.  Thus no root has both branches of Littlestone dimension at least two, proving the value is exactly two.
